title: Replace Enchantement
description: Provides a new enchantment that replaces the block you broke with the one in your off hand!
body:
# Replace Enchantment
![Showcases the functionality of the mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/20Ye2QV6/images/375d847fd06dea116c081dbf4b22164bcd71e1a8.gif)

With this mod, building becomes easy. Any blocks you've placed that you feel would be better off with another block now suddently becomes so much easier as now you just gotta follow these simple steps:
- Sneak
- Break
- Replace

With steps this easy, you could replace a whole beach from sand to red sand or an oak wall to spruce, the possibilities are endless!

The full steps to make work is to enchant your tool with the replace enchant, put the block you want to replace the current block with in your off hand, and break the block you want to replace while sneaking for it to work.

If you want a version without the enchantment and just pure replacing power, get the Replace Mod [here](https://modrinth.com/project/replace-mod)!
